headline: President-elect Mirza Fakhrul pays homage to Ziaur Rahman and Khaleda Zia
summary: The 23rd President of Bangladesh, elected with 255 votes, visited the graves of the BNP founder and former Prime Minister before taking his oath of office.
details: President-elect Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir paid his respects at the graves of BNP founder and former President Ziaur Rahman and former Prime Minister Khaleda Zia.
He was elected as the 23rd President of Bangladesh yesterday, Thursday, receiving 255 votes in a direct vote.
Prior to taking his oath of office this evening at Bangabhaban, the former BNP Secretary General visited the graves of his party's founder and long-time political ally.
The visit served as a symbolic gesture of respect and remembrance before he officially assumes the highest office in the country.
caption:
Before taking his oath as the 23rd President of Bangladesh, Mirza Fakhrul visited the graves of Ziaur Rahman and Khaleda Zia.

President-elect Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir paid his respects at the graves of BNP founder and former President Ziaur Rahman and former Prime Minister Khaleda Zia.

He was elected as the 23rd President of Bangladesh yesterday, Thursday, receiving 255 votes in a direct vote.

Prior to taking his oath of office this evening at Bangabhaban, the former BNP Secretary General visited the graves of his party's founder and long-time political ally.

The visit served as a symbolic gesture of respect and remembrance before he officially assumes the highest office in the country.

#Bangladesh #President #MirzaFakhrul #BNP #Politics #Dhaka

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, The Daily Star
